chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from al-Barqī, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Hishām ibn al-Ḥakam, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said: “O company of the Anṣār, indeed Allah has praised you well, so what is it that you do?” They said: “We cleanse ourselves with water.”

key_terms.بِالْمَاءِ: with water, as the means of purification
key_terms.مَعْشَرَ الْأَنْصَارِ: the community of the Anṣār addressed by the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.نَسْتَنْجِي: we perform istinjāʾ; we cleanse ourselves after relieving ourselves

ai.seo_question: What did the Anṣār do that earned Allah’s praise regarding ritual purity?
ai.summary: This hadith reports the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله praising the Anṣār and asking about the practice for which Allah commended them. They replied that they perform istinjāʾ with water, indicating the virtue and legal relevance of purification with water after relieving oneself.
